howItWorks.title: How pre-ordering works
howItWorks.metaDescription: Radhe Foods brings Indian groceries to Germany in delivery rounds. You pre-order before a deadline, we deliver, and you pay after delivery.
howItWorks.intro: We bring groceries from India to Germany in delivery rounds. For each round there is a deadline to order and a few announced delivery days. You pay only after your order has arrived.
howItWorks.a1: A binding order for the next delivery round. We buy and ship exactly what was ordered, so we need your order before the deadline shown on every page.
howItWorks.q2: Do I pay when I order?
howItWorks.a2: No. Nothing is charged when you confirm your pre-order. You see the full bill before you confirm: prices including VAT, the delivery fee and the total.
howItWorks.q3: When and how do I pay?
howItWorks.a3: After delivery you receive an invoice by email with a payment link. You can pay by card or PayPal, or in cash to our driver when Radhe Foods delivers itself. The invoice names the date by which to pay.
howItWorks.q4: Can I change or cancel my order?
howItWorks.a4: A placed order cannot be changed. You can cancel it in your account while it has not been sent, and order again as long as the pre-order is open.
howItWorks.q5: What if something is missing or damaged?
howItWorks.a5: You only pay for what was delivered in good order. We correct the bill, and you can ask for a return in your account after delivery.
howItWorks.q6: Why can I not order some products right now?
howItWorks.a6: Each delivery round has its own range. A product can be sold out for this round or not part of it; it is back with one of the next rounds.

delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.metaDescription: Delivery across Germany, delivery fees, delivery days, payment after delivery by card, PayPal or cash, and returns at Radhe Foods.
delivery.intro: What delivery costs, when it comes and how you pay.
delivery.areaText: We deliver to every address in Germany. Your order comes with our own driver or as a parcel with DHL or Hermes; we choose the way that suits your address and tell you when it is on its way, with a tracking link for parcels.
delivery.feeIntro: The fee depends on the value of the goods in your order. All prices in the shop include VAT; the delivery fee is added once per order.
delivery.feeUnknown: The delivery fee is shown in your cart before you order.

delivery.daysClosed: Ordering is closed right now. The deadline and the delivery days of the next pre-order are shown on every page as soon as it opens.
delivery.daysNote: Delivery days are an estimate. If a delivery round is delayed, we tell you by email.
delivery.payText: You do not pay when you order. After delivery we send you an invoice by email with a secure payment link.

delivery.payCash: Cash to our driver, when Radhe Foods delivers itself
delivery.payDeadline: The invoice names the date by which to pay. We send a reminder each day until it is paid. While a payment is past its date, new pre-orders are not possible.
